pro_course_detail.title: English conversation topics (adjustable for level): student's choice!
pro_course_detail.description:
We'll discuss fun topics together, and you get to choose! The structure is similar to conversation practice for test preparation, but more relaxed.

Topics:
City/town - We will chat about life in towns and cities, including our own! In my case I have lived in Miami and all over Spain.

Movies/series - We will talk about the movies and series we love (or hate)! 

Music - We will discuss our favorite genres and our own experiences! Everything from concerts and festivals, to our own performances and how music is viewed in our cultures.

Books and short stories - What makes a good story? Our favorite stories and what they mean to us.

Art - What is art? We may converse about different types of art, the art we create, art in our lives, and philosophic questions such as: what is beauty? Is art subjective or objective? What is the purpose of art in a society?

Philosophy - Subjects ranging from free will, the mind, different philosophers, metaphysics, ethics, or anything else the student is interested in.

Science - We can talk about different scientific discoveries, advancements and what we can expect in the future, life on other planets.

Sleep/dreams - Everything from our sleeping patterns to lucid dreaming (controlling our own dreams, something I can do, and maybe I can teach you how to do it too!)

Food - The foods in our countries, foods we love and hate, rstaurants, cooking, different diets (like vegetarian or vegan), and all things food!

Anecdotes - These can be anything that's happened to us or someone we know. Could be anything  ranging from fun adventures, scary moments, broken bones, times we got in trouble, or just anything you would like to share. 

Goals - Our plans for the future, dream jobs, and where we want to end up. A great way to practice the future tense!

Student's suggestion! - We can talk about anything you'd like! Make a suggestions and we can discuss it.

Combination - Combine any of the topics above for a fun and dynamic conversation class!

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be conversation based and YOU will be doing most of the speaking. Either you will pick topics or I will pick topics that are relevant to your English journey- you can decide.

I will correct some of your mistakes during the lesson. I don't correct every single mistake but I will either correct you on the spot or will note all important mistakes. Sometimes it's necessary to wait until you have completed a sentence or thought before any correction should be done- it's important to also practice flow when speaking a foreign language. 

You will receive feedback from me via email after (or at the very end of) each lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: General English lessons / Grammar lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons:

Our lessons will incorporate speaking, listening, writing, and grammar. Lessons will be tailored to meet your needs! I will send notes after each lesson, share relevant materials, and assign homework.

While we are in our lessons, we will probably divide the time up into two categories - speaking and grammar. Half the time we will focus on grammar, and half the time on speaking. Homework assigned will usually require you to do some writing, listening, reading, and definitely reviewing. 

After the first few lessons, I'll make a plan for us to follow- it's usually about a 40-lesson syllabus. We don't have to follow it, but it will be a helpful guide for us.

Grammar lessons:

In these lessons, we'll dive deep into all the questions that you might have about grammar. If you don't have specific questions, I will guide you with resources and I will explain with clarity how and why we formulate our sentences the way that we do. I will provide you with trustworthy, additional resources so you can learn from multiple perspectives. Our lessons will be completely customized to meet your needs.

Sometimes I teach grammar in the lessons and then assign homework- and sometimes I first assign homework and then the student "presents" what they've learned. Both systems work really well- the first system working well with A1-B2 students, and the second working well with B2-C1 students.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Workout*
pro_course_detail.description:
If you need to simply chat with a native speaker to practice your English, these informal conversation lessons are just for you. Perhaps you have a presentation you need to practice for, or a speaking exam tomorrow, or you're getting ready to travel abroad and need to warm up a bit. You will bring the topics and you will steer the conversation! 

*Lessons for adults only. Please note that if you'd like homework, lesson plans, or written feedback please take my speaking lessons instead.

pro_course_detail.title: English for young learners
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will be mostly conversation based with lots of activities and games, especially with very young learners. This is an important age for language learning because kids learn QUICKLY and EASILY, and they learn the best without formal teaching. Students are pushed to speak, but on their own time- I build trust and focus on their confidence before any formal teaching. With most of my younger learners, I encourage NO formal teaching; it is better that they see me as a "friend" rather than a teacher (kids have enough school already!). At the end of the day, the lesson style is up to the parent- if the parent prefers me to formally teach, I will do that. 
When I am not "formally teaching" I am noting the student's frequent mistakes and new words, and I use the drilling method. After lots of repetition they will naturally correct their mistakes. 
*I only teach 30 minute lessons with very young learners- if there is a specific circumstance we can discuss 45-minute lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Vocabulary, Accent and Pronunciation with Texts
pro_course_detail.description:
This format is best for those who want to expand their vocabulary and improve their accent.  Many people do not know that accent is more than just your pronunciation; it also includes your intonation patterns, the rhythm of your speech, and the fluency of your speech.  You can have perfect pronunciation but still not sound like a native if you lacking in the other areas of your speech.  

These classes are made to specifically work on accent reduction and building your vocabulary.  To do this, we will use text a digital text which you will read it aloud.  We will focus on specific vowel and consonant sounds , syllable and word stress, and rhythm patters to help you sound more like a native.  

Since we will be using native level content, you will also be exposed to new vocabulary, phrases and sayings.  We will discuss the text and I will help you with any doubts you have.  The texts will be on topics of interest to you so that you can use the vocabulary in your daily life.  The possibilities are endless and include:
- News articles
- Blog posts
- Short stories
- Passages from novels

You can also bring any material that you like, for example a book you are reading, a text for work, a novel for school, etc.  As long as you have the text in a digital format, we can use it in our sessions.

pro_course_detail.title: 7 Easy Ways to Improve Your Vocabulary Fast and Overcome the Struggle (A1 - C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Words are the basic blocks of the language, and one of the key predictors of someone’s education level, profession, and social status. Yet most students struggle to increase their vocabulary effectively, as unfamiliar words go one into one ear and out the other.

It’s not that we have difficulties grasping the vocabulary when we see it. Rather, we struggle to recall when we use it, or worse yet, forget to use it frequently enough only to end up back where we began.

This lesson will describe seven proven tactics to overcome this struggle and learn new words faster, recall them more effectively, and remember them forever.
